notAScore: This is practice. It is not a hiring probability.
aiProviderMissing: Needs the AI provider, which is not configured in this environment. Nothing was charged and no text interview was used.

feedback.relevanceMissing: Does not use the confirmed fact behind this question.
feedback.structureThin: Thin: add the situation, what you did, and the result.

errors.planStory: Your career plan does not include this.
errors.planText: Text interview practice is not included in your current plan. You can still save a STAR story from confirmed facts.
errors.quota: No text interviews left. This session was not started.
errors.idempotency: This request changed while it was being retried. Start it again.
errors.noFacts: Confirm at least one fact in your career profile first.
errors.sessionComplete: All questions in this session are answered.
errors.numberNotInFacts: That number is not in your confirmed facts.
errors.tooManyStories: You have the most stories one account can keep.
errors.factIds: Pick facts that are still confirmed in your profile.
errors.emptyText: Type something first (it can be long, but not empty).
errors.noConfirmedResult: A result must come from a confirmed achievement. Add the achievement to your profile and confirm it first.
errors.resultNotInFacts: That result is not in your confirmed achievements. Use the wording of a confirmed achievement.

fallback.load: Interview practice could not be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
fallback.start: This session was not started. Nothing was used. Try again.
fallback.answer: That answer was not saved. The words you typed are still here. Nothing extra was used.
fallback.challenge: Your note was not saved. It is still here; try again.
fallback.story: The story was not saved. Your words are still here; try again.
fallback.deleteStory: The story was not deleted. Try again.

list.title: Interview practice
list.locked: Career tools are not included in your plan
list.storiesBody: Situation, task, action, result from your confirmed facts. Saving a story does not use a text interview.
list.voiceBody: Answer out loud and record it. Time is counted by the second; the summary stays if you remove the recording.
list.startHelp: One text interview covers 3 to 10 questions (you choose), feedback, and a summary.
list.noOpportunities: Open a listing to practice against it. Save or paste one on the website first.
list.noneLeft: No text interviews left. A session cannot be started now.
list.emptyBody: Start one above for a saved opportunity or a role you type.
list.roleHint: For example, Data analyst. No saved opportunity is needed.
list.needsTarget: Pick a saved opportunity, or type a target role (at least 2 characters).
list.confirmBodyCount: This uses 1 text interview. {count} left. You get {questions} questions, feedback, and a summary.
list.sessionPickerHint: Going back to a session does not use another text interview.

session.title: Interview session
session.subtitle: Interview practice
session.writeDisagreeFirst: Write what you disagree with first.
session.challengeBody: Say what the feedback missed. Your note is saved with this answer. It does not change the feedback and uses no text interview.
session.notePlaceholder: For example: my answer did cite the project
session.reportLacking: {count, plural, one {Answer {list} did not cite confirmed evidence.} other {Answers {list} did not cite confirmed evidence.}}

stories.title: STAR stories
stories.subtitle: Interview practice
stories.savedBody: It is on your account with your other STAR stories.
stories.body: Situation, task, action, and result. A number that is not in your confirmed facts is refused. Saving a story does not use a text interview.
stories.factsHelp: Only confirmed facts. With none picked, the story is linked to all of them.
stories.noFacts: No confirmed facts yet. Confirm facts in your career profile first.
stories.emptyBody: Write one above from your confirmed facts.
stories.savedLine: Saved {date} · {count, plural, one {# fact} other {# facts}}
stories.resultRule: The result must come from a confirmed achievement in your profile: an award, promotion or figure that is not there is refused.
stories.deleteBody: It is removed from your library. Your confirmed facts stay as they are.
stories.discardBody: What you typed in the story form is not saved.
stories.fromAnswer: Started from your answer to question {index}. Edit each part, then save. The result must come from a confirmed achievement.

voice.notAScore: Feedback covers the words only. It does not judge emotion, honesty, or personality.

fallback.load: Voice practice could not be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
fallback.correct: The correction was not saved. Your words are still here.
fallback.delete: The recording was not removed. Try again.

errors.featureUnavailable: Voice practice is not open yet. It is switched off in this preview. Text practice stays available, and no credit was used.
errors.plan: Voice practice is not included in your current plan.
errors.transcript: Type the words you said first (up to 10,000 characters).
errors.noTake: This session has no recording on your account. Nothing was changed.

voice.title: Voice practice
voice.typeWordsFirst: Type the words you said first.
voice.correctionSaved: Correction saved. No extra time was used.
voice.removeBody: The audio file is deleted permanently. The transcript, feedback and summary stay. Time already used is not returned.
voice.audioDeleted: The recording is removed. The summary is still here.
voice.offTitle: Voice practice is not open yet
voice.offBody: It is switched off in this preview. Text practice stays available, and no credit was used.
voice.planTitle: Voice practice is not included in your current plan
voice.planBody: Text interview practice may still be available on your plan.
voice.savedTranscriptHelp: These words were typed. Saving a correction does not use more time, and no audio is sent to a transcription service.
voice.noTake: No take saved for this session.
voice.pendingTranscriptHelp: This take has no transcript yet. Type the words you said to get feedback on them; it uses no more time.
voice.transcribedHelp: These words came from automatic transcription. Correct anything it got wrong; a correction uses no more time.
voice.emptyBody: Open a practice question above to record your first take.
voice.consent: I agree to record this practice on my account.
voice.consentWithdrawHelp: You can withdraw consent at any time by unticking the box. Recordings you already made stay until you delete them.
voice.consentWithdrawn: Consent withdrawn. New recordings need your consent again.
voice.forListing: The question is for the listing you opened.
voice.pickListing: Name a role above, or open a saved listing to practice for it.
voice.openFree: Opening a question uses no time. Only recorded seconds are counted.
voice.chargeOperation: Before you record: voice practice recording
voice.chargeCost: Uses voice time equal to the length of the recording, counted by the second from the audio file. This take stops by itself at {max}.
voice.chargeBalance: You have {time} left ({seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}).
voice.chargeTranscriptionIncluded: Transcription and feedback are included in that time.
voice.chargeTranscriptionOff: Automatic transcription is not connected yet: after recording, you type what you said to get feedback. Feedback is included in that time.
voice.recorderError: The recording stopped with nothing captured. No time was used. Check your microphone and try again.
voice.takePreview: Listen to this take before saving
voice.takeReady: About {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} recorded. Saving uses the exact length measured from the file; discarding uses nothing.
voice.billed: {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of voice time used for this recording.
voice.feedbackPending: Feedback appears once the words of your answer are saved.
voice.audioRemovedState: Audio removed. The transcript and summary were kept.
voice.saveFailedBody: No time was used. Your recording is still on this page; try saving it again.
voice.audioUnreadable: This recording could not be measured, so it was not saved and no time was used. Record the answer again.
voice.audioTooLarge: This recording is too long to upload. No time was used. Record a shorter answer.
voice.noFacts: Confirm at least one line on your career profile first. Questions are built only from confirmed facts.
voice.transcribed: The recording was transcribed. Check the words and correct them if needed; corrections use no time.
voice.transcriptionUnavailable: Your recording is saved. Automatic transcription is not connected yet, so type what you said below to get feedback. That uses no extra time.
voice.transcriptionFailed: Your recording is saved, but it could not be transcribed. Type what you said below to get feedback. That uses no extra time.
voice.truncated: The recording was longer than the time you had left. Only the remaining seconds were counted.
voice.earlierHelp: Open an earlier session to listen, read the feedback or finish the transcript. Opening one uses no time.
voice.earlierRecorded: {seconds, plural, one {# second recorded} other {# seconds recorded}}
voice.micDenied: Microphone access was refused. Allow the microphone for FlacronCV in your phone settings, then start again. No time was used.
voice.micAskAgain: Microphone access is needed to record. Tap Start recording again and allow it. No time was used.
voice.actionFailed: That did not work. Nothing was changed. Try again.
voice.startFailed: The question was not opened. Nothing was used. Try again.
voice.playFailed: The recording could not be played. Nothing was changed. Try again.
voice.consentA11y: Agree to record this practice on my account
voice.backgroundStopped: Recording stopped when the app left the screen. Listen to the take, then save or discard it.
